title: Myths vs Facts: ‘My Glucose Is Fine Because My Fasting Number Is Normal’—Why This Misses Postprandial Hyperglycemia, Oxidative Stress, and Endothelial Dysfunction
description: Debunks the false security of fasting-only monitoring using data on post-meal ROS generation, flow-mediated dilation impairment, and retinal capillary dropout.
